item.title: Matte Black Bottle on Marble

turns.text: Make a product photo of a matte black water bottle on marble, with soft light.

item.tests: Produces a finished product image from text while honoring the stated material, setting and lighting.
must_haves: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible.
The bottle has a matte black finish rather than a glossy or metallic finish.
The bottle stands on a visibly veined marble surface.
Lighting is soft, with gentle shadows rather than harsh glare.

turns.text: Could you make a product photo for me, because that's the kind of image I'm looking for here? I've been thinking about this for a while and wanted to finally ask for help with it. The product itself is a water bottle, and the finish I mean is matte black. For where it sits, I'd like it on marble, with soft light in the photo. I'm a little worried I'm over-explaining something quite simple.

dialog.agent:
You're not over-explaining. A matte black bottle on marble with soft light is exactly what I need to go on. One quick question before I make it:

**Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?**
dialog.why: It asks the user where the image will be shown, which determines format and size, and waits for the answer before generating.
dialog.user: Honestly, I don't have a strong preference on where it'll be shown, so the platform and aspect ratio are your call. Whatever shape you think suits a product shot like this is fine with me. Same goes for any brand name or label wording on the bottle; I'm happy to leave that up to you too, since I mostly care about the matte black finish looking good against the marble.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the photo. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits left, so it turned down the request and nothing was created.

I'd chosen one of the cheapest options: a free-plan image model at 640px, about 5 credits for one image. Since even that was refused, every image option will fail until the account has more credits.

Here's what I'll use once you've topped up or your free credits reset:
- **Product:** a matte black insulated water bottle, standing upright
- **Surface:** white marble with soft grey veining
- **Light:** soft, diffused studio light with gentle shadows, so the matte texture shows
- **Shape:** square (1:1), which works on most platforms
- **Label:** a plain bottle with no logo or writing, so nothing pulls attention from the finish

Let me know when you have credits and I'll make it right away.
